findings.title: Per-issue environment lookup issues extra queries on a hot path
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() once per issue while building the PR comment. Each call can hit nodestore or Snuba, so a comment with many issues adds a per-issue query cost. The broad `except Exception` also hides real failures behind an info-level log.

findings.title: Template ends with a trailing newline and the comment layout changes
findings.body: MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE ends with "\n", and the callers then join the items with "\n". This produces blank lines between bullets plus an extra trailing blank line before the footer. The tests encode this spacing, so it is likely unintended. Separately, the subtitle/culprit is dropped from the comment, which is a behaviour change.

findings.title: Static method reaches into a different class
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template is a staticmethod, and it calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title by class name. It sits next to code that appears to be in CommitContextIntegration, so it is unclear whether PRCommentWorkflow is the enclosing class. If it is not, this raises NameError or couples the two classes by accident.

findings.title: Editing already-shipped migrations to no-ops
findings.body: The bodies of migrations 0917 and 0920 are replaced with no-ops, on the claim that they "never ran". Any environment that already applied them keeps the converted data, while new environments skip it. The comment points to a 0921 migration that is not in this diff. The 0917 test was also deleted.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning changed from "low" to "off"
findings.body: This changes the default behaviour for all projects that have not explicitly set the option, and nothing in the PR description mentions it. The change is silent and unrelated to the stated purpose of the PR.

findings.title: Error fetch and the replay Snuba query add failure paths and mismatch IDs
findings.body: query_replay_instance is now called on every request and is not wrapped in error handling, so a Snuba failure turns a summary request into a 500. In fetch_error_details, `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes get_multi preserves order and returns an entry for every id. A missing or reordered entry attaches the wrong event_id to the data. Also, on_results mutates error_events with an in-place sort.

findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization rendered with empty data when the flag is on
findings.body: With the feature flag enabled, the widget renders TableWidgetVisualization with `columns=[]` and an empty `tableData`. The actual `result.data` and `meta` are ignored, so the table shows no data. This is incomplete code behind a flag.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before the feature check
findings.body: analytics.record runs before the feature-flag check, so events are emitted for organizations without the feature. It also uses request.user.id, which is None for org-auth-token requests. The event declares user_id as optional, so this does not fail, but it is noisy data.

findings.title: Rows without segments skip the delete but are still archived
findings.body: When max_segment_id is None, no recording files are deleted. The replay is still archived via delete_replays. This is probably fine, but any recordings that exist without ClickHouse segment rows are orphaned.
